name: NetEsp32
description: ESP32-only adapters for NetEngine: EspWifiPort (WiFi + ESPmDNS), AsyncMqttTransport (AsyncMqttClient), EspOtaPlatform (esp_ota_ops + the strong verifyRollbackLater() override), WebServerHost (AsyncWebServer + ElegantOTA + Wi-Fi/version endpoints, gated by an injected RequestGate, with a two-phase route installer and the PROGMEM rescue page), AdminAuth (the only credential store: constant-time verify + epoch), RequestGate (gate interface, sendGateDenied, routeMatcher over the WebEngine route table), EspotaService and the ConnectivityServices facade.
